summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, announcing the submission of an automatic shelf registration statement on Form F-3 with the SEC, including a prospectus for an at-the-market offering of up to $200 million in ADSs. No specific price per share, premium, or deal terms are provided. The board is pleased to announce the filing. This is a routine capital markets activity—establishing a shelf facility for potential future equity issuance under a well-known seasoned issuer status. There is no change of control, acquisition, or special situation event. Watch for future takedown announcements and potential dilution effects.
